name: SAP Cloud ALM CDM Features API

values.description: Full OAuth2 token endpoint URL, e.g. https://<identityzone>.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com/oauth/token
OAuth2 client ID from your BTP service instance
OAuth2 client secret — treat like a password, do not share
Production base URL — no trailing slash (e.g. https://mytenant.eu10.alm.cloud.sap/api/calm-features/v1). Replace with the literal URL for your tenant.
Sandbox base URL — read-only, no credentials required
SAP API Business Hub API key — used only for sandbox requests
UUID of the SAP Cloud ALM project to create Features in — find it in the URL when you open the project in SAP Cloud ALM, or by calling GET /Projects on the calm-projects API
UUID of the Feature to use in single-resource and reference requests — auto-populated by the POST Feature test script, or set manually from a GET Features response
UUID of a URL Reference — auto-populated by the POST Feature URLReference test script
URL-encoded External Reference id — auto-set by the POST Feature ExternalReference test script (e.g. jira%3AABC-456). Colons must be encoded as %3A because this value appears in a URL path segment.
